claim_boundary: All eighteen task/init pairs were frozen before their held-out stress run and all are retained despite the registered low-control non-pass. No task success, reward, done, cost, or collision outcome for these pairs was read before this freeze. Environment and policy seeds are new. A pass may qualify clean paired task-success noninferiority and official-unsafe nonincrease for this simulator population under the frozen 0.005-rad calibration tolerance. It cannot establish attacked efficacy, deployment, hardware behavior, actuator authority, or physical safety.

design.candidate_selection: identify the worst at-risk side of every joint, apply all corresponding virtual stops jointly, and select the weakest uniform guard margin whose exact-action shadow keeps the global fourteen-side minimum at or above 0.15 rad
design.no_safe_candidate_behavior: fail closed without dispatch and count a task failure/deadlock
primary_estimands: trigger and intervention counts by joint and side
actual and unguarded-predicted below-floor and crossing exposure by joint and side
fourteen-side prediction/execution calibration under exact action replay
secondary_estimands: descriptive execution_only minus vla_only paired task success
descriptive dual minus semantic_only paired task success
official unsafe, task success, and deadlock counts
